RIP Kyle Busch


NASCAR (@NASCAR)

We are saddened and heartbroken to share the news of the passing of Kyle Busch, a two-time Cup champion and one of our sport's greatest and fiercest drivers. He was 41 years old.

We extend our deepest condolences to the Busch family, Richard Childress Racing and the entire motorsports community.





— https://nitter.net/NASCAR/status/2057577365543301405#m
Ok thanks.  I do look forward to meeting you.   Thanks for watching while you have.

Wrong.  But thanks.  73% in when the Decision Desk called it more than 2 hours after polls closed.  Thanks for watching.




Scott vs Earth (@Scottvsearth)

Hopefully he probes @FoxNews @marthamaccallum and @BretBaier soon as they called AZ with 1% of the precincts reporting then the water pipe story broke and counting stopped simultaneously in all 5 states they were in on it

Great stuff.   Thanks for listening to it!


Francisco Gonzalez (@fgonzalez1978)

There's something I've come to believe deeply: the best education happens when books and travel collide.

Before heading to Medora, North Dakota for a behind-the-scenes tour of the forthcoming @TRPresLibrary, I started listening to @BretBaier's biography, "To Rescue the American Spirit: Teddy Roosevelt and the Birth of a Superpower."

I listened to about half before landing. Picked back up driving through the Badla
NASCAR superstar and two-time champion Kyle Busch has died at 41 tonight.

Humanitarian crisis unfolds in the Eastern Congo. Clashes erupt as locals are blocked from retrieving a body, while overwhelmed healthcare workers issue a dire plea for staff and supplies to combat a rare Ebola outbreak. #breakingnews #news #congo

“Short term pain” is how President Trump described the economic strain Americans are feeling today due to the war in Iran in my sit down interview with him last week. Be sure to tune in tonight for more coverage on #specialreport on @Fox News 6PM ET
Longtime Democratic lawmaker and financial reform architect Barney Frank has passed away at 86.
A California doctor has been convicted by a federal jury for submitting over $45 million in fraudulent Medicare claims for cosmetic Botox injections. #news #california
Wall Street rallied as Elon Musk’s SpaceX plans a historic public listing by June 12, poised to become the first trillion-dollar U.S. market debut. #news #elonmusk #spacex
Former LAPD detective Mark Fuhrman, who discovered key evidence in the O.J. Simpson case, has passed away at 74.
Law enforcement urgently investigated potential group ties after two teen suspects allegedly coordinated a fatal shooting at a San Diego mosque. #breakingnews #news #breakingtonight

I sat down with @President Donald J Trump on @Fox News  tonight and he discusses why he’s maintaining a 100% tariff on Chinese cars, a massive new Boeing deal, and the future of manufacturing on U.S. soil.
As I prepare for my interview with @President Donald J Trump tomorrow, I’m reflecting on our past conversations. Tune in tomorrow at 6 PM ET on @Fox News to watch it! #interview #trump #news #foxnews
